text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking by the dance studio when I
see Narita
Top Road practicing
vigorously.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... That was terrible! But I'm not giving up yet! Okay, one more time!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Class Rep! Thank goodness I found
you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Whoa! What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
It's b-b-bad! Real bad! C'mon, hurry!
Everyone
needs you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Uh oh. This must be a real emergency.
Okay, lead
the way!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Okay! And... oh! Could you come too?
Having an
adult around would make us
feel a lot better!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Is everything okay?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Class Rep! You came! And you even
brought a
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
What a relief... Now we'll actually have a
fighting
chance at passing tomorrow's
makeup exam!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry! I was in such a rush that I forgot
to
explain the situation...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: But this is terrible, and we need your help! Please help us study! We're done for otherwise!
choice_data_list_en: I was wondering what all the fuss was about...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind sticking around, but Narita
Top Road
was in the middle of dance
practice. I look her
way worriedly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hehe... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm so relieved. I thought someone
had gotten
hurt or something! I'm so
glad it was nothing
serious.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'd be happy to help with your
studies.
I'm a strict teacher, though, so
be prepared to
work hard!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Thank youuu! You're a lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's fine. I can practice whenever.
What about
you, though? Do you have
the time?
choice_data_list: 自分の練習はいいのか？
choice_data_list_en: Don't you have your own practice to worry about?
Aren't you worried about your own practice?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you so much!
choice_data_list: 予定はないから、付き合うよ
choice_data_list_en: I don't have plans, so I'll come along.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's split up the work. First, we need to
get a
grasp on what we're dealing with
and determine
what will be on the test
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Next, we'll analyze the situation, figure
out what
they don't understand, and
tackle everything
they're struggling with!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone. Time to get serious!
Let's get
you all passing scores
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious to know how the makeup
exam went,
so I visit the students'
classroom the next day.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Yessss! I passed! Thank you so much!
You really
saved us!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! You made everything so
easy to
understand! We would've been
goners without
you, Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. All I did was help. You're the
ones who
put in all the work!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hi! And yeah, she really is! Top
Road's so
good at everything—school,
dancing, races... but
she's so humble
about it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Aw, you're exaggerating!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But thank you! I'm just really glad I was
able to
help you all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road smiles brightly. She's
the picture
of a model student!
